query: Oracle Health Cerner revenue electronic health records
normalized: cerner electronic health oracle records revenue

output.content:
Oracle Health, formerly Cerner, is Oracle’s electronic-health-record (EHR) business, centered on the Cerner Millennium EHR platform. [[1]] 

Cerner generated **$5.506 billion of revenue in calendar 2020** and **$5.76 billion in calendar 2021**, before Oracle’s acquisition. [[2]] [[3]] 

Following the acquisition, Cerner contributed approximately **$5.9 billion of revenue in Oracle fiscal 2023**, ended May 31, 2023; its Q4 contribution was about **$1.5 billion**. [[4]] 

Oracle does **not** separately report Oracle Health/Cerner revenue in its standard FY2024 results; it reported consolidated FY2024 revenue of **$52.961 billion**, including **$5.594 billion of services revenue**, rather than a distinct EHR-business revenue line. [[5]] 

Thus, **$5.9 billion for FY2023 is the clearest disclosed post-acquisition annual Cerner revenue figure**, while later Oracle Health revenue must generally be inferred from Oracle’s consolidated reporting rather than treated as a separately reported EHR segment. [[4]] [[5]]
